_meta.status: DRAFT wording from ASSESSMENT_DESIGN.md - requires method-owner review and piloting

cards.scenario: A big crowd arrives at the stall all at once.

options.text: Jump to the front and greet them
Get things ready behind the counter

cards.scenario: Ustad Karim says you can decorate the stall any way you like.

options.text: Try a bold new idea nobody has done before
Use the design that worked well last year

cards.scenario: Bilal used the paint you were saving.

options.text: Let it go, he probably needed it
Tell him he should have asked first

cards.scenario: A visitor offers you a snack flavour you've never heard of.

options.text: Try it right away, just to find out
Stick with a flavour you already like

cards.scenario: You get a list of ten jobs to finish before lunch.

options.text: Plan the order first, then start
Jump in and sort it out as you go

cards.scenario: The stall plan suddenly changes.

options.text: Feel a bit stressed by the change
Just roll with it

cards.scenario: It's lunch break.

options.text: Eat with a big group from other stalls
Eat quietly with one good friend

cards.scenario: You get a free half hour during setup.

options.text: Wander to stalls you know nothing about
Hang out at the stall you already know well

cards.scenario: The team votes for a plan you don't like.

options.text: Go along with it to keep everyone happy
Argue for your plan before agreeing

cards.scenario: The banner is done, but one corner looks a bit messy.

options.text: Fix it until it's neat
It looks fine from far away, so move on

cards.scenario: Ustad Karim needs the stock count by tomorrow.

options.text: Do it today so it's finished
Do it tomorrow morning, there's time

cards.scenario: Dark clouds are gathering over the mela ground.

options.text: Keep checking the sky, a bit worried
Shrug: whatever happens, happens

cards.scenario: Someone needs to make an announcement on the mic.

options.text: Volunteer to do it yourself
Help someone else write it

cards.scenario: Hira shows you a book of old Pakistani folk art.

options.text: Spend time imagining new patterns from it
Pick a pattern that looks good and move on

cards.scenario: Another stall asks to borrow your extension cord.

options.text: Lend it right away
Check that you won't need it first

cards.scenario: After a long day the team is going out for chai.

options.text: Go along, more time together sounds fun
Head home to recharge

cards.scenario: Your table is covered in paint, tape and paper.

options.text: Tidy up before the next job
Keep going and tidy up at the end

cards.scenario: You make a small mistake in front of everyone.

options.text: Keep thinking about it for a while
Laugh it off and move on

cards.scenario: New volunteers have just joined.

options.text: Go and introduce yourself to everyone
Wait until they come over to you

cards.scenario: The team is choosing a theme for the stage.

options.text: Suggest something unusual, like 'a mela on the moon'
Suggest a classic theme everyone will recognise

cards.scenario: A visitor is rude about your stall.

options.text: Stay polite and kind
Tell them firmly that it isn't okay

cards.scenario: A friend wants the same job you wanted.

options.text: Let them have it
Suggest you decide fairly, like taking turns

cards.scenario: You promised to bring string from home tomorrow.

options.text: Set a reminder so you don't forget
Trust yourself to remember in the morning

cards.scenario: Tomorrow is the big mela day.

options.text: You'll probably lie awake thinking about it tonight
You'll sleep easily tonight

cards.scenario: The stall is quiet for a while.

options.text: Call out to passers-by to come and see
Enjoy the calm and tidy up

cards.scenario: Bilal asks, "Why do people love melas so much?"

options.text: Enjoy thinking it through together
Say "for the food!" and get back to work

cards.scenario: A younger student makes a mistake on the price chart.

options.text: Fix it quietly so they don't feel bad
Point it out so they learn for next time

cards.scenario: The judges arrive an hour early!

options.text: Your heart races and you worry it isn't ready
Stay calm, it's ready enough

cards.scenario: The rule says stalls close at 6 o'clock.

options.text: Pack up right on time
Finish what you're doing, even if it runs late

cards.scenario: Ustad Karim says, "Come and see me later."

options.text: Wonder what you did wrong
Assume it's nothing serious
